Is there any special flag to fill that kind of tests? I'm getting this error: ``` Error: StateTestFiller convertion error: Unexpected field 'data' in config: StateTestInFiller validInvalid "validInvalid" : { "_info" : { "comment" : "Test various examples to see if they are valid or invalid.
Implements
# >@f1
EOF1V0001 code with branches having the same stack height
# <@f1
" }, "data" : [ ":label valid :raw 0x

 000c # Code section 0 , 12 bytes
 030048 # Data section length ( 36 )
 00 # Terminator (end of header)

Which is cmd line? It must be -t EOFTests the filler has to be in the EOFTest directory? Yes EOFTests Ok, now I'm getting a different error: Seems like retesteth is sending the flag `--output.errorlog` to `evm t8n`, but this flag is not expected by the t8n tool: ``` flag provided but not defined: -output.errorlog /home/hugo/.retesteth/default/start.sh --state.fork Shanghai --state.reward -1 --input.alloc /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b/alloc.json --input.txs /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b/txs.rlp --input.env /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b/env.json --output.basedir /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b --output.result out.json --output.alloc outAlloc.json --output.errorlog /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b/error.json Err: Response test_setChainParams: The command '/home/hugo/.retesteth/default/start.sh --state.fork Shanghai --state.reward -1 --input.alloc /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b/alloc.json --input.txs /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b/txs.rlp --input.env /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b/env.json --output.basedir /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b --output.result out.json --output.alloc outAlloc.json --output.errorlog /dev/shm/0e6f9ea2-ebdb-41e7-9901-2649ea75702b/error.json' exited with 256 code. Finishing retesteth run *** Total Tests Run: 0 ``` Using this command: `retesteth -t EOFTests -- --testpath /home/hugo/workspace/tests/ --filltests --verbosity 6`
